entries.title: A home for your runbooks
entries.body: Runbooks now has its own Settings tab, with common guidance first and your own runbooks grouped separately. View a built-in as a read-only temporary copy, or open your runbooks folder. Ask the first mate to make lasting guidance or a skill for every crewmate, or customize a built-in for you.

picture.alt: The Runbooks tab follows Intelligence and lists built-ins from Common workflows to Lessons, each with View and a switch

exclusions.reason: The Markdown sections and generated code fallback preserve the served text byte for byte; the visible settings and authoring result are covered by runbooks-settings.
